Name: Nikolaus von Zinzendorf
Summary: German count who gave persecuted Moravian refugees a home on his estate at Herrnhut, led a community of round-the-clock prayer, and dispatched missionaries to the Caribbean, Greenland, and beyond.
Contribution: Sheltered Protestant refugees at Herrnhut and sent out the Moravian missionaries who pioneered Protestant world missions.
Testimony: He testified that the Lamb who was slain is worthy of the whole earth, and organised a community to live as if it were true.
